verdict.rationale: Composio Connect is documented as a hosted MCP server at https://connect.composio.dev/mcp. Any MCP-compatible client can use it to reach 1000+ apps through one shared URL, with no SDK session needed. Sessions created with `mcp: true` and `composio.mcp.create` also expose hosted MCP URLs scoped to specific toolkits, so there is nothing for the developer to deploy. The one community report concerns a single Instagram connection error, not the hosted MCP endpoint, so it does not dispute the capability. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the hosted MCP URL works end-to-end, and documented client-side setup and auth steps for connecting a third-party MCP client to the URL.
